```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    SELECT component_id, per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM bill_of_materials
    WHERE assembly_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'FR-M63S-38')
      AND start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= end_date)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.component_id, be.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = be.component_id AND p.make_flag = true
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = be.component_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(be.qty), 0) AS total_qty
FROM bom_explosion be
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = be.component_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'MS-2341';
```

```sql
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- All BOM component paths from each top-level product, with cumulative quantity
bom_paths AS (
    SELECT
        b.assembly_id AS root_product_id,
        b.component_id AS component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        bp.root_product_id,
        b.component_id,
        bp.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bp.component_id AND p.make_flag = true
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = bp.component_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Crankset product ids
cranksets AS (
    SELECT p.product_id
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON ps.subcategory_id = p.subcategory_id
    WHERE ps.name = 'Cranksets'
),
-- Southwest territory
sw AS (
    SELECT territory_id FROM sales_territory WHERE name = 'Southwest'
),
-- Direct sales of cranksets
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT sol.product_id, SUM(sol.order_qty) AS qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sw ON sw.territory_id = so.territory_id
    WHERE so.online_order = false
      AND extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2025
      AND sol.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM cranksets)
    GROUP BY sol.product_id
),
-- Component sales of cranksets (cranksets contained in sold products)
component_sales AS (
    SELECT bp.component_id AS product_id, SUM(sol.order_qty * bp.qty) AS qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sw ON sw.territory_id = so.territory_id
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON bp.root_product_id = sol.product_id
    WHERE so.online_order = false
      AND extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2025
      AND bp.component_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM cranksets)
    GROUP BY bp.component_id
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(qty) FROM direct_sales), 0)
     + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(qty) FROM component_sales), 0) AS total_units;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Orders in Canada territory in 2025
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM sales_order o
    JOIN sales_territory t ON o.territory_id = t.territory_id
    WHERE t.name = 'Canada'
      AND extract('year' FROM o.order_date) = 2025
),
-- Order lines for those orders
order_lines AS (
    SELECT sol.order_id, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty, co.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN canada_orders co ON sol.order_id = co.order_id
),
-- Recursive BOM explosion: track product, order_date, qty multiplier
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Anchor: the sold product itself (direct units)
    SELECT ol.product_id AS component_id, ol.order_date, ol.order_qty * 1.0 AS qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive: components of manufactured products
    SELECT bom.component_id, be.order_date, be.qty * bom.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = be.component_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(be.qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM bom_explosion be
```

```sql
    FROM bill_of_materials
    WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND start_date <= DATE '2021-08-10'
      AND (end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2021-08-10' <= end_date)
),
-- BOM valid on 2025-06-30 (current)
bom_cur AS (
    SELECT assembly_id, component_id, per_assembly_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials
    WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= end_date)
),
-- recursive expansion for old BOM
exp_old AS (
    SELECT component_id AS product_id, per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM bom_old
    WHERE assembly_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'BK-M18S-44')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.component_id, e.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM exp_old e
    JOIN bom_old b ON b.assembly_id = e.product_id
),
-- recursive expansion for current BOM
exp_cur AS (
    SELECT component_id AS product_id, per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM bom_cur
    WHERE assembly_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'BK-M18S-44')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.component_id, e.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM exp_cur e
    JOIN bom_cur b ON b.assembly_id = e.product_id
),

    FROM exp_cur
    WHERE product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'SH-4562')
)

FROM cur_total, old_total;
```

```sql
  FROM orders o
  JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id
  UNION ALL
  -- recursive: components of manufactured items
  SELECT e.order_id, e.order_date, c.child_code, e.qty * c.qty
  FROM explosion e
  JOIN product pp ON pp.product_number = e.item_code AND pp.make_flag = true
  JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = e.item_code
  WHERE c.valid_from <= e.order_date
    AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= c.valid_to)
)
```

```sql
-- orders in Central territory in 2025
central_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM sales_order o
    JOIN sales_territory t ON o.territory_id = t.territory_id
    WHERE t.name = 'Central'
      AND extract('year' FROM o.order_date) = 2025
),
-- order lines of those orders
lines AS (
    SELECT l.product_id, l.order_qty, co.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line l
    JOIN central_orders co ON l.order_id = co.order_id
),
-- direct sales of MS-2348
direct AS (
    SELECT SUM(l.order_qty) AS qty
    FROM lines l
    JOIN product p ON l.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'MS-2348'
),
-- BOM explosion per order line, valid on order date
explosion AS (
    SELECT l.product_id AS root_id, l.order_qty, l.order_date,
           c.child_code, c.qty AS edge_qty
    FROM lines l
    JOIN product p ON l.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = p.product_number
    WHERE c.valid_from <= l.order_date
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR l.order_date <= c.valid_to)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.root_id, e.order_qty, e.order_date,
           c.child_code, e.edge_qty * c.qty
    FROM explosion e
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = e.child_code AND p.make_flag = true
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = e.child_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= e.order_date
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= c.valid_to)
),
contained AS (
    SELECT SUM(e.order_qty * e.edge_qty) AS qty
    FROM explosion e
    WHERE e.child_code = 'MS-2348'
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT qty FROM direct), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT qty FROM contained), 0) AS total_demand;
```

```sql
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN canada_orders co ON sol.order_id = co.order_id
),
-- Direct demand: units sold directly if the product itself is TT-M928
direct_demand AS (
    SELECT SUM(l.order_qty) AS qty
    FROM lines l
    JOIN product p ON l.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'TT-M928'
),
-- Recursive BOM explosion per order line, using BOM valid on order date
bom AS (
    -- Anchor: direct children of each sold product

    FROM lines l
    JOIN product p ON l.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = p.product_number
    WHERE c.valid_from <= l.order_date
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR l.order_date <= c.valid_to)
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive: expand manufactured children
    SELECT b.order_id, b.order_date, b.order_qty,
           c.child_code,
           b.total_qty * c.qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN product p ON b.item_code = p.product_number
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = b.item_code
    WHERE p.make_flag = TRUE
      AND c.valid_from <= b.order_date
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR b.order_date <= c.valid_to)
),

    SELECT SUM(total_qty) AS qty
    FROM bom
    WHERE item_code = 'TT-M928'
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all Touring Bikes
touring_bikes AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.product_number
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
      AND ps.name = 'Touring Bikes'
),
-- Find the component product_id for 'RC-0291'
target_component AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'RC-0291'
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOMs: find all components at any level for each Touring Bike
-- Start with direct components of each touring bike
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Anchor: direct components from BOM lines where assembly is a touring bike
    SELECT 
        tb.product_id AS bike_id,
        tb.product_number AS bike_number,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        bom.bom_level
    FROM touring_bikes tb
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = tb.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not header rows
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: components of sub-assemblies that are make_flag=true
    SELECT 
        be.bike_id,
        be.bike_number,
        bom.component_id,
        be.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        bom.bom_level
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true  -- only expand manufactured items
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
-- Count distinct bikes that have RC-0291 at any level
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bike_id) AS bike_count
FROM bom_explosion
WHERE component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_component);
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bike_products AS (
    -- Find all Mountain Bikes
    SELECT p.product_id, p.product_number, p.name
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
      AND ps.name = 'Mountain Bikes'
),
current_bom AS (
    -- All current BOM lines (excluding header rows with NULL assembly_id)
    SELECT assembly_id, component_id, per_assembly_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials
    WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= end_date)
),
bom_paths AS (
    -- Anchor: start from each mountain bike as the top-level assembly
    SELECT 
        bp.product_id as root_product_id,
        cb.component_id,
        cb.per_assembly_qty as total_qty
    FROM bike_products bp
    JOIN current_bom cb ON cb.assembly_id = bp.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: follow BOM down to sub-components
    SELECT 
        bp.root_product_id,
        cb.component_id,
        bp.total_qty * cb.per_assembly_qty as total_qty
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN current_bom cb ON cb.assembly_id = bp.component_id
),
target_component AS (
    -- Find the product_id for component CB-2903
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'CB-2903'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bp.root_product_id) as bike_count
FROM bom_paths bp
WHERE bp.component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_component)
```

```sql
        parent_code,
        child_code,
        qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-31'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2025-01-01')

        u.child_code,
        b.qty * u.qty,
        u.valid_from,
        u.valid_to

    JOIN u_composition u

    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, find all Road Bikes
road_bikes AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.product_number, p.name
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
      AND ps.name = 'Road Bikes'
),
-- Find the component product MB-2024
target_component AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'MB-2024'
),
-- Recursive CTE to explore all BOM levels for each Road Bike
bom_paths AS (
    -- Anchor: start with direct components of each Road Bike (BOM level 1)
    SELECT 
        rb.product_id AS bike_id,
        rb.product_number AS bike_number,
        rb.name AS bike_name,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        bom.bom_level AS level
    FROM road_bikes rb
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = rb.product_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- exclude header rows
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        bp.bike_id,
        bp.bike_number,
        bp.bike_name,
        bom.component_id,
        bp.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        bom.bom_level AS level
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bp.component_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true  -- only manufactured products have BOMs
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- exclude header rows
)
-- Count distinct bikes that have MB-2024 at any level
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bike_id) AS bike_count
FROM bom_paths bp
WHERE bp.component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_component);
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bike_bom AS (
    -- Anchor: get the two bikes
    SELECT 
        p.product_id AS root_product_id,
        p.product_number AS root_product_number,
        p.product_id AS assembly_id,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS cumulative_qty
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_number IN ('BK-T44U-46', 'BK-M18B-52')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand BOM components
    SELECT 
        bb.root_product_id,
        bb.root_product_number,
        bom.component_id AS assembly_id,
        bb.cumulative_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS cumulative_qty
    FROM bike_bom bb
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = bb.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= bom.end_date)
      AND bom.component_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Get all parts (leaf nodes, i.e., purchased components or the bike itself if no BOM) for each bike
bike_parts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        bb.root_product_number,
        bb.assembly_id AS part_id,
        bb.cumulative_qty
    FROM bike_bom bb
    WHERE bb.assembly_id NOT IN (
        -- Exclude assemblies that have their own current BOM
        SELECT DISTINCT bom.assembly_id 
        FROM bill_of_materials bom
        WHERE bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
          AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= bom.end_date)
          AND bom.component_id IS NOT NULL
    )
),
-- Get parts in BK-T44U-46
parts_in_t44u AS (
    SELECT part_id FROM bike_parts WHERE root_product_number = 'BK-T44U-46'
),
-- Get parts in BK-M18B-52
parts_in_m18b AS (
    SELECT part_id FROM bike_parts WHERE root_product_number = 'BK-M18B-52'
)
-- Parts in BK-T44U-46 but not in BK-M18B-52
SELECT p.product_number
FROM parts_in_t44u t
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = t.part_id
WHERE t.part_id NOT IN (SELECT part_id FROM parts_in_m18b)
ORDER BY p.product_number;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all order lines for Central territory in 2025 with their order dates
central_orders_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.territory_group = 'Central'
      AND extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2025
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM: for each product sold, find all components at all levels
bom_exploded AS (
    -- Anchor: start with products that were directly ordered
    SELECT 
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.order_qty,
        co.order_date,
        co.product_id AS component_id,
        1.0::DOUBLE AS per_assembly_qty,
        0 AS bom_level
    FROM central_orders_2025 co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow BOM to get components
    SELECT 
        be.root_product_id,
        be.order_qty,
        be.order_date,
        bom.component_id,
        be.per_assembly_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS per_assembly_qty,
        be.bom_level + 1 AS bom_level
    FROM bom_exploded be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- exclude header rows
),
-- Get the product number for MS-2348 to identify it
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'MS-2348'
)
-- Sum total demand: direct sales + contained in assemblies
SELECT 
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT SUM(order_qty) 
         FROM central_orders_2025 co 
         JOIN target_product tp ON co.product_id = tp.product_id),
        0
    ) 
    +
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT SUM(be.order_qty * be.per_assembly_qty)
         FROM bom_exploded be
         JOIN target_product tp ON be.component_id = tp.product_id),
        0
    ) AS total_demand
```

```sql
canada_territory AS (

    FROM sales_territory 
    WHERE name = 'Canada'

-- Get orders from Canada in 2023
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN canada_territory ct ON so.territory_id = ct.territory_id
    WHERE extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2023
),

-- Get product_id for PD-R853
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'PD-R853'
),

-- Recursive BOM explosion: for each order, find all components at all levels
-- Start with products directly ordered
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Anchor: the products that were ordered (level 0, they themselves)
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        co.product_id AS assembly_id,
        co.product_id AS component_id,
        co.order_qty AS per_assembly_qty,
        0 AS bom_level,
        co.order_qty AS total_qty  -- quantity at this level
    FROM canada_orders co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: explode components
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty,
        be.bom_level + 1,
        be.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date 
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- exclude header rows
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all order lines for Australia in 2025 with their order dates
australia_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Australia'
      AND extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2025
),
-- Find the product_id for part PA-632U
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'PA-632U'
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOMs: for each product sold, find all components at all levels
-- We need to track: the original product_id (what was sold), component_id, quantity multiplier, and order_date
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Anchor: start with products that were directly ordered (level 0: the product itself)
    -- This handles "units sold directly" for PA-632U if it was sold as a product
    SELECT 
        ao.product_id AS root_product_id,
        ao.product_id AS component_id,
        1.0 AS total_qty_per_unit,
        ao.order_date,
        ao.order_qty,
        0 AS bom_level
    FROM australia_orders ao
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also anchor: start with BOM components of products that have BOMs
    -- (only for products that are assemblies, i.e., have BOM entries)
    SELECT 
        ao.product_id AS root_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty_per_unit,
        ao.order_date,
        ao.order_qty,
        1 AS bom_level
    FROM australia_orders ao
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = ao.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= ao.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR ao.order_date <= bom.end_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow BOMs down for components that are themselves assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.root_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.total_qty_per_unit * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty_per_unit,
        be.order_date,
        be.order_qty,
        be.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true  -- only follow down if this component is manufactured (has its own BOM)
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      AND be.bom_level >= 0
)
-- Sum up total demand for PA-632U: direct sales + component usage at all levels
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(be.total_qty_per_unit * be.order_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM bom_explosion be
JOIN target_part tp ON be.component_id = tp.product_id
```

```sql
    FROM product

bom_parts AS (
    -- Anchor: start with the top-level product
    SELECT 
        p.product_id AS root_product_id,
        p.product_id AS assembly_id,
        NULL::INT AS component_id,
        1.0 AS total_qty,
        0 AS bom_level
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_id IN ((SELECT bike1_id FROM target_products), (SELECT bike2_id FROM target_products))
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow BOM lines to components
    SELECT 
        bp.root_product_id,
        bom.component_id AS assembly_id,
        NULL::INT AS component_id,
        bp.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        bom.bom_level
    FROM bom_parts bp
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bp.assembly_id = bom.assembly_id
    CROSS JOIN current_date_val cd
    WHERE bom.start_date <= cd.d 
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR cd.d <= bom.end_date)
      AND bom.component_id IS NOT NULL
      -- Only follow if the component is an assembly (make_flag = true), otherwise it's a leaf part
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = bom.component_id AND p.make_flag = true)
),

    SELECT DISTINCT
        bp.root_product_id,

      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = bom.component_id AND p.make_flag = false)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include the root product itself if it's a purchased part (though bikes are typically assemblies)
    SELECT 
        p.product_id AS root_product_id,
        p.product_id AS part_id,
        1.0 AS total_qty
    FROM product p

-- Get distinct part IDs for each bike
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
bom_hierarchy AS (
    -- Anchor: find all products that are assemblies containing MS-1981 at any level
    -- Start from direct BOM lines where component is MS-1981
    SELECT 
        b.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        b.start_date,
        b.end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN product p ON b.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'MS-1981'
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: go up the BOM tree to find all assemblies that contain these subassemblies
    SELECT 
        b.assembly_id,
        bh.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty * bh.total_qty AS total_qty,
        GREATEST(b.start_date, bh.start_date) AS start_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN b.end_date IS NULL THEN bh.end_date
            WHEN bh.end_date IS NULL THEN b.end_date
            ELSE LEAST(b.end_date, bh.end_date)
        END AS end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN bom_hierarchy bh ON b.component_id = bh.assembly_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Get the product_id for MS-1981
ms1981_product AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'MS-1981'
),
-- Get territory_id for Central
central_territory AS (
    SELECT territory_id FROM sales_territory WHERE name = 'Central'
),
-- Direct sales of MS-1981 in Central in 2023
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(sol.order_qty), 0) AS direct_qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN ms1981_product mp ON sol.product_id = mp.product_id
    JOIN central_territory ct ON so.territory_id = ct.territory_id
    WHERE extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2023
),
-- Component demand: for each order line, find if the product contains MS-1981
component_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(
            sol.order_qty * bh.total_qty
        ) AS component_qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bom_hierarchy bh ON bh.assembly_id = p.product_id
    JOIN central_territory ct ON so.territory_id = ct.territory_id
    WHERE extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2023
      AND so.order_date >= bh.start_date
      AND (bh.end_date IS NULL OR so.order_date <= bh.end_date)
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT direct_qty FROM direct_sales) + 
    COALESCE((SELECT component_qty FROM component_demand), 0) AS total_demand
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all order lines for Northwest territory in 2022 with their order dates
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northwest'
      AND extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2022
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOMs: find all components at all levels
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Anchor: start with products that were ordered, with their order qty
    SELECT 
        ol.product_id AS assembly_id,
        ol.product_id AS component_id,
        ol.order_qty AS total_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        1 AS bom_level,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS per_assembly_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow BOM to get components
    SELECT 
        be.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.total_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.bom_level + 1,
        be.per_assembly_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
),
-- Get the product_number for NI-4127
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'NI-4127'
)
-- Sum demand: direct sales (level 1 where assembly = component = NI-4127) 
-- plus contained parts (level > 1 where component = NI-4127)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(be.total_qty * be.per_assembly_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM bom_explosion be
JOIN target_product tp ON be.component_id = tp.product_id
WHERE be.component_id = tp.product_id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, find all order lines for products sold in Canada in 2022 with their order dates and quantities
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2022
),
-- Find the product_id for part CR-7833
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'CR-7833'
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOMs: for each product sold, find all components at all levels
-- We need to track: the original product_id sold, the component_id at current level, the cumulative quantity, and the order_date for BOM validity
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Anchor: start with products that have BOMs (assemblies), get their direct components
    -- Also include the case where the sold product IS the target part (direct sales)
    SELECT 
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.product_id AS current_product_id,
        co.order_qty AS cumulative_qty,
        co.order_date,
        0 AS bom_level,
        -- Flag if this is the direct product (no BOM traversal yet)
        TRUE AS is_direct
    FROM canada_orders co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand components that are assemblies (make_flag = true) and have BOMs
    SELECT 
        be.root_product_id,
        bom.component_id AS current_product_id,
        be.cumulative_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS cumulative_qty,
        be.order_date,
        bom.bom_level,
        FALSE AS is_direct
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product p ON be.current_product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.current_product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
),
-- Combine direct sales of the target part with all BOM-derived demands
all_demand AS (
    -- Direct sales: when the root product itself is the target part
    SELECT 
        root_product_id,
        cumulative_qty,
        order_date,
        is_direct
    FROM bom_explosion
    WHERE current_product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_part)
      AND is_direct = TRUE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- BOM-derived demand: when a component at any level is the target part
    SELECT 
        root_product_id,
        cumulative_qty,
        order_date,
        is_direct
    FROM bom_explosion
    WHERE current_product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_part)
      AND is_direct = FALSE
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cumulative_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM all_demand;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, get all order lines for Canada territory in 2025 with their order dates
canada_orders_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2025
),
-- Find the product_id for part MS-2341
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'MS-2341'
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOMs: for each product sold, find all components at all levels
-- We need to track: the original product sold, the component at current level, quantity multiplier, and date
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Anchor: start with products that were directly sold in orders
    -- These are the "level 0" - the product itself
    SELECT 
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.product_id AS component_id,
        co.order_qty AS total_qty,
        co.order_date,
        1.0::DOUBLE AS per_assembly_qty,
        0 AS bom_level
    FROM canada_orders_2025 co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand components that are assemblies (make_flag = true)
    -- and have valid BOM lines on the order date
    SELECT 
        be.root_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.total_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.per_assembly_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty,
        be.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON p.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
      AND bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
),
-- Combine direct sales and all exploded components
all_demand AS (
    -- Direct sales of MS-2341 (level 0 where root is MS-2341 itself)
    SELECT 
        root_product_id,
        component_id,
        total_qty AS demand_qty,
        order_date
    FROM bom_explosion
    WHERE component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_part)
      AND bom_level = 0
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Components at any level that are MS-2341
    SELECT 
        root_product_id,
        component_id,
        (total_qty * per_assembly_qty)::INT AS demand_qty,
        order_date
    FROM bom_explosion
    WHERE component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_part)
      AND bom_level > 0
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(demand_qty), 0)::BIGINT AS total_demand
FROM all_demand
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all order lines for UK territory in 2024 with their order dates
uk_orders_2024 AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'United Kingdom'
      AND extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2024
),
-- Get the product_id for part TT-R982
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'TT-R982'
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM: find all paths from sold products to components
-- Starting from products that were sold, walk down the BOM to find all components
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Anchor: start with products that were sold directly
    SELECT 
        uo.product_id AS top_level_product_id,
        uo.product_id AS current_product_id,
        uo.order_qty AS base_qty,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS cumulative_qty,
        uo.order_date
    FROM uk_orders_2024 uo
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow BOM down to components
    SELECT 
        be.top_level_product_id,
        bom.component_id AS current_product_id,
        be.base_qty,
        be.cumulative_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS cumulative_qty,
        be.order_date
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.current_product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
),
-- Calculate total demand for TT-R982
-- This includes: direct sales of TT-R982 + TT-R982 as a component at any level
direct_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(uo.order_qty), 0) AS direct_units
    FROM uk_orders_2024 uo
    JOIN target_part tp ON uo.product_id = tp.product_id
),
component_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(be.base_qty * be.cumulative_qty), 0) AS component_units
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN target_part tp ON be.current_product_id = tp.product_id
    -- Exclude the anchor level where current_product_id = top_level_product_id 
    -- because that's direct sales, already counted in direct_demand
    WHERE be.top_level_product_id != be.current_product_id
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT direct_units FROM direct_demand) + 
    (SELECT component_units FROM component_demand) AS total_demand
```

```sql
-- First, find all orders from Canada territory in 2022
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2022
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM: find all components at any level
-- Start with products sold directly, then recurse through BOM
bom_exploded AS (
    -- Anchor: products sold directly (treat as level 0, qty 1)
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        co.product_id AS assembly_id,
        co.product_id AS component_id,
        1.0 AS per_assembly_qty,
        0 AS bom_level
    FROM canada_orders co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: find components of current assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.per_assembly_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS per_assembly_qty,
        be.bom_level + 1 AS bom_level
    FROM bom_exploded be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
),
-- Calculate total demand: for each order line, sum of (order_qty * exploded_qty) for all occurrences of MB-6061
-- This includes direct sales (where component_id = product_id and bom_level = 0) and contained parts
mb_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        co.product_id AS sold_product_id,
        co.order_qty,
        be.per_assembly_qty,
        co.order_qty * be.per_assembly_qty AS total_component_qty
    FROM bom_exploded be
    JOIN canada_orders co ON be.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'MB-6061'
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_component_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM mb_demand
```

```sql
bom_recursive AS (
    -- Anchor: start with bike products as top-level assemblies
    SELECT 
        bp.product_id as top_level_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty as total_qty,
        bom.bom_level
    FROM bike_products bp
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bp.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= DATE '2022-12-31'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2022-01-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand components that are themselves assemblies
    SELECT 
        br.top_level_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        br.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty as total_qty,
        bom.bom_level
    FROM bom_recursive br
    JOIN product p ON br.component_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON p.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2022-12-31'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2022-01-01')
),
-- Get all components (including direct product itself) for each bike
product_demand AS (

        bp.product_id as top_level_product_id,
        bp.product_id as component_id,
        1.0 as qty_per_unit
    FROM bike_products bp
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- All BOM components
    SELECT 
        br.top_level_product_id,
        br.component_id,
        br.total_qty as qty_per_unit
    FROM bom_recursive br
),
```

```sql
    SELECT 
        bp.product_id AS top_level_product_id,
        bp.product_number,
        COALESCE(bom.component_id, bp.product_id) AS component_id,
        COALESCE(bom.per_assembly_qty, 1) AS total_qty,
        0 AS bom_level
    FROM bike_products bp
    JOIN order_lines ol ON bp.product_id = ol.product_id
    LEFT JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bp.product_id = bom.assembly_id
        AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
        AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= bom.end_date)
    WHERE bom.bom_id IS NULL OR bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand components that are assemblies
    SELECT 
        br.top_level_product_id,
        br.product_number,
        bom.component_id,
        br.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        br.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_recursive br

      AND br.bom_level < 10

    FROM bom_recursive br
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all order lines for Central territory in 2025 with their order dates
central_orders_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.territory_group = 'Central'
      AND extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2025
),
-- Find the product_id for FR-T98Y-54
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'FR-T98Y-54'
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM: for each product, find all its components at all levels
-- We need to find paths from any product to FR-T98Y-54, so we reverse the BOM direction
-- Start from FR-T98Y-54 and find what assemblies it's in, going upward
bom_paths AS (
    -- Anchor: FR-T98Y-54 itself (as a component of itself with qty 1)
    SELECT 
        tp.product_id as component_id,
        1.0 as per_assembly_qty,
        tp.product_id as root_product_id,
        1 as bom_level
    FROM target_product tp
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: find assemblies that contain the current component
    -- bom.assembly_id is the parent, bom.component_id is the child
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id as component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty * bp.per_assembly_qty as per_assembly_qty,
        bp.root_product_id,
        bp.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bp.component_id = bom.component_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= bom.end_date)
),
-- Get valid BOM lines for each specific order date (not just current)
-- We need to re-derive the BOM explosion per order date since BOM validity depends on date
-- Actually, let's rebuild: for each order line product, explode its BOM valid on that order date
order_bom_explosion AS (
    -- Anchor: each ordered product is itself a "component" with qty 1
    SELECT 
        co.product_id as root_product_id,
        co.product_id as component_id,
        1.0 as total_qty,
        co.order_qty,
        co.order_date,
        0 as level
    FROM central_orders_2025 co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: find components of current assemblies
    SELECT 
        obe.root_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        obe.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty as total_qty,
        obe.order_qty,
        obe.order_date,
        obe.level + 1
    FROM order_bom_explosion obe
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON obe.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.component_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
      AND bom.start_date <= obe.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR obe.order_date <= bom.end_date)
),
-- Calculate total demand for FR-T98Y-54
demand_calculation AS (
    SELECT 
        obe.order_qty * obe.total_qty as total_demand_units
    FROM order_bom_explosion obe
    JOIN target_product tp ON obe.component_id = tp.product_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_demand_units), 0) as total_demand
FROM demand_calculation
```

```sql
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BB-9108'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find assemblies that contain the current product in their BOM
    SELECT 
        p.product_id AS root_product_id,
        bom.component_id AS current_product_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty * bp.qty_multiplier AS qty_multiplier,

    FROM southwest_orders so

        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_unit,
        so.order_date,
```

```sql
-- We need to find how FK-9939 is used as a component at any level
bom_paths AS (
    -- Anchor: direct usage of FK-9939 as a component
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id AS top_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_multiplier,
        bom.start_date,
        bom.end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    WHERE bom.component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_product)
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: FK-9939 is nested deeper in the BOM
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id AS top_product_id,
        bp.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty * bp.qty_multiplier AS qty_multiplier,
        GREATEST(bom.start_date, bp.start_date) AS start_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN bom.end_date IS NULL THEN bp.end_date
            WHEN bp.end_date IS NULL THEN bom.end_date
            ELSE LEAST(bom.end_date, bp.end_date)
        END AS end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON bom.component_id = bp.top_product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),

-- Also include FK-9939 sold directly (as itself being the top product)
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id AS top_product_id,
        product_id AS component_id,
        1.0 AS qty_multiplier,
        DATE '1900-01-01' AS start_date,
        NULL::DATE AS end_date
    FROM target_product
),

-- Combine all paths
all_paths AS (
    SELECT * FROM bom_paths
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM direct_sales
),

-- Calculate demand: for each order, find matching BOM paths valid on order date
demand_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        no.order_id,
        no.order_date,
        no.product_id AS ordered_product_id,
        ap.qty_multiplier,
        no.order_qty,
        ap.qty_multiplier * no.order_qty AS total_component_qty
    FROM northwest_orders no
    JOIN all_paths ap ON no.product_id = ap.top_product_id
    WHERE no.order_date >= ap.start_date
      AND (ap.end_date IS NULL OR no.order_date <= ap.end_date)
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_component_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM demand_calc
```

```sql
canada_orders AS (

    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2023
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM: find all paths from any product to FR-R92R-62
-- We need to find how much FR-R92R-62 is contained in each product sold
bom_paths AS (
    -- Anchor: direct components that are FR-R92R-62
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id AS top_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        bom.start_date,
        bom.end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN target_product tp ON bom.component_id = tp.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: go up the BOM tree (find products that contain assemblies)
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id AS top_product_id,
        bp.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty * bp.total_qty AS total_qty,
        GREATEST(bom.start_date, bp.start_date) AS start_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN bom.end_date IS NULL THEN bp.end_date
            WHEN bp.end_date IS NULL THEN bom.end_date
            ELSE LEAST(bom.end_date, bp.end_date)
        END AS end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON bom.component_id = bp.top_product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),

-- Calculate demand: for each order, check if the ordered product contains FR-R92R-62
-- Also include direct sales of FR-R92R-62 itself
demand_calc AS (
    -- Direct sales of FR-R92R-62
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        co.order_qty AS demand_qty
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN target_product tp ON co.product_id = tp.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Indirect demand through BOM
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        co.order_qty * bp.total_qty AS demand_qty
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON co.product_id = bp.top_product_id
    WHERE co.order_date >= bp.start_date
      AND (bp.end_date IS NULL OR co.order_date <= bp.end_date)
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_paths AS (
    -- Anchor: Find all BOM lines for ST-9828 as a component on 2021-10-16
    -- We need to find assemblies that directly contain ST-9828
    SELECT 
        b.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    WHERE b.component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'ST-9828')
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2021-10-16'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2021-10-16')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: Walk up the BOM tree to find higher-level assemblies
    SELECT 
        b.assembly_id,
        bp.assembly_id AS component_id,  -- the previous assembly becomes the component
        b.per_assembly_qty * bp.per_assembly_qty,
        bp.level + 1
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON b.component_id = bp.assembly_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2021-10-16'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2021-10-16')
),
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get the product_id for FR-R38B-62
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'FR-R38B-62'
),
-- Get the product_id for part MS-2341
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'MS-2341'
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM for a given date, calculating quantity per unit of top-level product
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Anchor: start with the target product as assembly, quantity 1 per unit of itself
    SELECT 
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty_per_unit,
        b.bom_level
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    CROSS JOIN target_product tp
    WHERE b.assembly_id = tp.product_id
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2021-06-08'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2021-06-08' <= b.end_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow components that are assemblies (make_flag = true)
    SELECT 
        b.component_id,
        be.qty_per_unit * b.per_assembly_qty AS qty_per_unit,
        b.bom_level
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = be.component_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = be.component_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2021-06-08'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2021-06-08' <= b.end_date)
),
-- Same for current date
bom_explosion_current AS (
    SELECT 
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty_per_unit,
        b.bom_level
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    CROSS JOIN target_product tp
    WHERE b.assembly_id = tp.product_id
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        b.component_id,
        be.qty_per_unit * b.per_assembly_qty AS qty_per_unit,
        b.bom_level
    FROM bom_explosion_current be
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = be.component_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = be.component_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
),

    WHERE be.component_id = tp.product_id
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all order lines for Central territory in 2025 with their product numbers and order dates
central_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.line_id,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date,
        p.product_number
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON COALESCE(so.territory_id, c.territory_id) = st.territory_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE st.territory_group = 'Central'
      AND extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2025
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM: find all paths from sold products to their components
bom_exploded AS (
    -- Anchor: the products sold directly (level 0)
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.line_id,
        co.product_number AS parent_code,
        co.product_number AS child_code,
        co.order_qty AS qty,
        co.order_date,
        1.0 AS path_qty  -- quantity multiplier along this path
    FROM central_orders co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow composition edges that are valid on the order date
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_id,
        uc.parent_code,
        uc.child_code,
        be.qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.path_qty * uc.qty AS path_qty
    FROM bom_exploded be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON be.child_code = uc.parent_code
    WHERE be.order_date >= uc.valid_from
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),
-- Calculate total demand for each component per order line
component_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        line_id,
        child_code AS component_code,
        qty * path_qty AS total_component_qty
    FROM bom_exploded
)
-- Sum demand for part MS-2348
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_component_qty), 0) AS total_demand_ms2348
FROM component_demand
WHERE component_code = 'MS-2348'
```

```sql
        sol.product_id,

        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
```
```sql
    JOIN canada_territory ct ON so.territory_id = ct.territory_id
    WHERE extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2022
```
```sql
),
```

```sql
-- Start with products that have outgoing BOM edges (make_flag = true)

    -- Anchor: start with products that are sold and have BOMs
    -- We need to find paths from sold products to part MB-6061
    -- Actually, let's start from the sold products and expand down
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.line_id,
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.product_id AS current_product_id,
        p.product_number AS current_product_number,
        CAST(co.order_qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_qty,
        co.order_date,
        1 AS level
    FROM canada_orders_2022 co
    JOIN product p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true  -- Only start recursion if product has a BOM
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand to children
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_id,
        be.root_product_id,
        p_child.product_id AS current_product_id,
        p_child.product_number AS current_product_number,
        be.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.level + 1
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON be.current_product_number = uc.parent_code
    JOIN product p_child ON uc.child_code = p_child.product_number
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= be.order_date 
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),

-- Get direct sales of MB-6061 (where it's sold directly, not as component)
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.line_id,
        co.order_qty AS qty
    FROM canada_orders_2022 co
    JOIN part_mb ON co.product_id = part_mb.product_id
),

-- Get all usages of MB-6061 as a component in BOM expansions

    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_id,

    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN part_mb ON be.current_product_id = part_mb.product_id
    WHERE part_mb.make_flag = false  -- MB-6061 is a part (purchased)
),

-- Combine direct sales and component usages
all_demand AS (
    SELECT qty FROM direct_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT qty FROM component_usages
)

FROM all_demand
```

```sql
        p.product_number,
        p.make_flag
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON COALESCE(so.territory_id, c.territory_id) = st.territory_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northwest'
      AND extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2022
),
-- Recursive BOM explosion: find all paths from sold products to part NI-4127
-- We need to find how much NI-4127 is contained in each product sold
bom_paths AS (
    -- Anchor: direct composition edges valid on order date
    SELECT 
        ol.order_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.product_number as root_code,
        uc.child_code,
        uc.qty as path_qty,
        uc.valid_from,
        uc.valid_to
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN u_composition uc ON ol.product_number = uc.parent_code
    WHERE ol.make_flag = true  -- only manufactured products have BOMs
      AND ol.order_date >= uc.valid_from
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR ol.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
      AND uc.child_code = 'NI-4127'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow composition edges down
    SELECT 
        bp.order_qty,
        bp.order_date,
        bp.root_code,
        uc.child_code,
        bp.path_qty * uc.qty as path_qty,
        GREATEST(bp.valid_from, uc.valid_from) as valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN bp.valid_to IS NULL THEN uc.valid_to
            WHEN uc.valid_to IS NULL THEN bp.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(bp.valid_to, uc.valid_to)
        END as valid_to
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN u_composition uc ON bp.child_code = uc.parent_code
    JOIN product p ON uc.parent_code = p.product_number
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND bp.order_date >= uc.valid_from
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR bp.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
      AND bp.order_date >= bp.valid_from
      AND (bp.valid_to IS NULL OR bp.order_date <= bp.valid_to)
      AND uc.child_code = 'NI-4127'
),
-- Get direct sales of NI-4127

    SELECT 
        order_qty as total_direct_qty
    FROM order_lines
    WHERE product_number = 'NI-4127'

    FROM bom_paths bp
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get the product_id for 'HB-T721'
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_number
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'HB-T721'
),
-- Get UK territory
uk_territory AS (
    SELECT territory_id
    FROM sales_territory
    WHERE name = 'United Kingdom'
),
-- Get all orders from UK in 2024
uk_orders_2024 AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN uk_territory ut ON so.territory_id = ut.territory_id
    WHERE extract('year' FROM so.order_date) = 2024
),
-- Get order lines for products that might contain HB-T721 (directly or indirectly)
-- We need to find all products whose BOM contains HB-T721, plus HB-T721 itself
bom_paths AS (
    -- Anchor: HB-T721 as a component of itself (for direct sales)
    SELECT 
        p.product_number as root_code,
        p.product_number as item_code,
        1.0 as qty,
        DATE '1900-01-01' as valid_from,
        NULL::DATE as valid_to
    FROM target_product tp
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = tp.product_number
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also anchor: all direct compositions where HB-T721 is the child
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_code as root_code,
        uc.child_code as item_code,
        uc.qty,
        uc.valid_from,
        uc.valid_to
    FROM u_composition uc
    WHERE uc.child_code = 'HB-T721'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: go up the BOM tree (find parents of current roots)
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_code as root_code,
        bp.item_code,
        uc.qty * bp.qty as qty,
        GREATEST(uc.valid_from, bp.valid_from) as valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN uc.valid_to IS NULL AND bp.valid_to IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN uc.valid_to IS NULL THEN bp.valid_to
            WHEN bp.valid_to IS NULL THEN uc.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(uc.valid_to, bp.valid_to)
        END as valid_to
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.child_code = bp.root_code
    WHERE bp.item_code = 'HB-T721'
),
-- Get all valid root->item combinations on each order date with their quantities
valid_bom_on_date AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        bp.root_code,
        bp.item_code,
        bp.qty,
        bp.valid_from,
        bp.valid_to
    FROM bom_paths bp
),
-- For each order line, find if the product is a root that contains HB-T721 on that date
order_line_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        sol.product_id,
        p.product_number,
        so.order_date,
        -- Direct demand if the product itself is HB-T721
        CASE WHEN p.product_number = 'HB-T721' THEN sol.order_qty ELSE 0 END as direct_demand,
        -- Indirect demand if the product's BOM contains HB-T721 valid on order date
        COALESCE((
            SELECT bp.qty * sol.order_qty
            FROM valid_bom_on_date bp
            WHERE bp.root_code = p.product_number
              AND bp.item_code = 'HB-T721'
              AND bp.valid_from <= so.order_date
              AND (bp.valid_to IS NULL OR so.order_date <= bp.valid_to)
            LIMIT 1
        ), 0) as indirect_demand
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN uk_orders_2024 so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
)
SELECT 
    SUM(direct_demand + indirect_demand) as total_demand
FROM order_line_demand
```
